title.en: The Girl Who Loved to Learn

source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بضيعة صغيرة، كان في بنت اسمها ليلى.
sentences.en: In a small village, there was a girl named Layla.

sentences.ar: ليلى كانت تحب المدرسة أكتر من أي شي.
sentences.en: Layla loved school more than anything.

sentences.ar: بس المدرسة كانت بعيدة، بساعة مشي.
sentences.en: But the school was far, an hour's walk away.

sentences.ar: كل الصبح، كانت تصحى بدري وتمشي لحالها.
sentences.en: Every morning, she would wake up early and walk by herself.

sentences.ar: بالشتا، كانت تمشي تحت المطر والبرد.
sentences.en: In winter, she would walk under the rain and cold.

sentences.ar: ناس الضيعة قالوا: ليش تتعب حالها هيك؟
sentences.en: The village people said: why does she tire herself like this?

sentences.ar: بس أبوها كان يقول: بنتي رح تصير شي كبير.
sentences.en: But her father would say: my daughter will become something great.

sentences.ar: ليلى كانت الأولى على صفها كل سنة.
sentences.en: Layla was first in her class every year.
The teachers were proud of her.
When she grew up, she went to the university in the city.
She studied day and night, and succeeded with excellence.
She returned to the village, but this time as a teacher.

sentences.ar: فتحت مدرسة قريبة عشان البنات ما يتعبوا متلها.
sentences.en: She opened a school nearby so girls wouldn't struggle like her.
She became a role model for every girl in the village.
And her father was the proudest father in the world.
